category_title: Impulsive male students prone to rule-breaking and interruptions
scenario_title: Off-task interruptions and lack of motivation for reading
minimal_context: The student is sitting in a circle in a locked classroom during the first session, where the goal is to listen to the facilitator read a short text to initiate a dialogue.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Welcome to our first session. Now that we are all sitting in a circle, I am going to read this short text out loud so we can start our dialogue.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Do we really have to do this? I don't want to listen to a story.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's just try to get through the first page together.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks around the room, ignoring the text) This is taking forever. Hey, what are we having for lunch today?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please focus on the reading for now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Turns completely away from the tutor to face another participant) I'm not listening to this. Hey, did you hear what happened in the yard earlier? This is so boring.

dialogue_combined:

TUTOR: Please focus on the reading for now.

STUDENT: (Turns completely away from the tutor to face another participant) I'm not listening to this. Hey, did you hear what happened in the yard earlier? This is so boring.
